🫏 New post ready 📚 List · friendship · 8 slides “habits of friends who never make you feel late” 📝 Slides
1. habits of friends who never make you feel late 2. sending a blurry photo of a street sign with no caption, just because it was your running joke at sixteen. 3. answering an out-of-the-blue text like you only stepped out of the room for a glass of water. 4. stopping to talk to your mum in the cereal aisle for ten minutes without mentioning how long it has been. 5. picking up the phone on a tuesday night without once asking where have you been. 6. mailing a birthday card every august, even if it still goes to your parents' old address. 7. sliding into a diner booth across from you and picking up a sentence from three years ago. 8. save this for the friend who never asks for an apology when life gets quiet.
✍️ Caption
we get busy with work, rent and tired evenings, but an old friend never counts the quiet months against you. save this for a slow sunday when you finally dial their number. #childhoodfriends #longdistancefriendship #friendshipquotes
